description: This file defines a Android Fragment class called LogFragment which manages a log display UI component using a custom LogView. It handles layout inflation, view setup with styling and layout parameters, and ensures the log scrolls to the bottom when new text is added.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays log messages in a custom LogView, with automatic scrolling to the latest logs.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, typeface, padding, gravity, and text appearance, then returns the root view containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to inflate views, set up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll the log view, and return the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the internal LogView instance.
